metadata.title: Gutsy – Artisan Burgers & Cocktails | Carcavelos
metadata.description: Artisan burgers with quality ingredients, cocktails, and good vibes in Carcavelos. Vegetarian options, outdoor seating, and free parking. Book a Table.

hero.tagline: Artisan burgers crafted with quality ingredients, cocktails, and enjoyable moments with friends and family. Carcavelos' favourite burger house.

about.body:
At Gutsy, we craft artisan burgers with the finest ingredients — 100% beef, São Jorge island cheese, local produce, and freshly baked buns. Every burger is made with care and served with pride in the heart of Carcavelos.

But we offer more than food — we offer enjoyable moments with friends and family. Life passes in an instant. Enjoy that moment with those you love. Pair your burger with one of our signature cocktails and settle in on our outdoor terrace.

items.title: Artisan Burgers
items.description: Handcrafted burgers with 100% beef, São Jorge cheese, and quality local ingredients — never mass-produced.

items.title: Cocktails & Drinks
items.description: Mojitos, Negronis, Aperol Spritz, Caipirinhas, and more — a full cocktail menu to complement your meal.

items.title: Vegetarian & Vegan
items.description: Tofu and Seitan burgers, veggie wraps, and fresh salads — everyone eats well at Gutsy.

items.title: Outdoor Seating
items.description: Enjoy your meal on our terrace in the heart of Carcavelos, with free WiFi and a relaxed atmosphere.

items.title: Kid-Friendly
items.description: Highchairs available, a dedicated kids menu with mini burgers, and a welcoming family atmosphere.

items.title: Easy Reservations
items.description: Book your table directly on our website. Walk-ins also welcome — free parking available nearby.

reviews.subtitle: Real feedback from real burger fans.

items.quote: Best burger in Lisbon, hands down. The smash technique makes all the difference — that crust is incredible.
items.name: Ana P.

items.quote: I've been coming every week since they opened. The Smoky burger is absolutely unreal. Never gets old.
items.name: Miguel R.

items.quote: Finally, proper American-style smash burgers in Portugal. Gutsy absolutely nailed it. Worth every cent.
items.name: Tom H.

items.quote: Perfect for a quick lunch. Always fresh, always hot, always exactly what you want from a burger joint.
items.name: Sofia M.

items.quote: The loaded fries alone are worth the trip. I don't know what they put in that cheese sauce but I need more.
items.name: Pedro C.

items.quote: Great vibe, great food, great price. This is our go-to Friday night spot. The milkshakes are dangerous.
items.name: Mariana L.

items.question: How do I book a table?
items.answer: You can book directly on our website or call us at +351 21 828 5795. Walk-ins are also welcome — we're happy to seat you if there's space.

items.question: Are there vegetarian options?
items.answer: Absolutely. We have Tofu and Seitan burgers, a Vegetable Wrap, and several fresh salads. There's something for everyone.

items.question: What are your opening hours?
items.answer: Monday to Thursday 12:00–23:00, Friday and Saturday 12:00–23:30, Sunday 12:00–23:00.

items.question: Do you have parking?
items.answer: Yes! We have free off-street parking available near the restaurant.

items.question: Is there outdoor seating?
items.answer: Yes, we have a lovely outdoor terrace. It's the perfect spot for a relaxed meal in Carcavelos, especially on sunny days.

items.question: Is Gutsy kid-friendly?
items.answer: Absolutely. We have highchairs, a kids menu with mini burgers and a drink, and a welcoming atmosphere for families.

contact.body: Got a question, a big group, or just want to say hi? Reach out — we're friendly. Find us on Instagram @gutsyoriginal and Facebook /GutsyOriginal.
